content.short: Venly NFT API enables minting and managing NFT collections across multiple blockchains.
content.description: Venly NFT API empowers developers to mint and manage NFT collections across multiple blockchains by offering tools to design smart contracts that mint NFTs and fungible tokens directly into user wallets. It also supports updating NFT metadata and storing media assets with Venly’s storage solutions. The no-code NFT API simplifies NFT contract deployment, reducing the need for blockchain development expertise. With Venly NFT API, the client remains the contract owner, and the API supports ERC721 and ERC1155 standards.
content.meta: Venly NFT API is an NFT tooling solution. Discover Venly NFT API and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
